forum.title: HAL_NVIC_EnableIRQ()  not generated with checkbox enabled for EXTI
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Adriano Melis

I reproduced the behavior and the **HAL\_NVIC\_EnableIRQ**(EXTI3\_IRQn); was generated on gpio.c file.

I recommend that you use the latest STM32CubeMX Version 6.17.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/930f41ba-9592-4a95-8013-c8bf60738336.png)

I will be waiting for your feedback.

Thanks.

MAHMOUD
